preserved_chat_ideas.statement: Merlin as local-first research and engineering workbench; recursive improvement with explicit authority boundary.
CACE/Expert Robot/Hermes separation, typed capabilities, sandboxing and independent verification.
MCFC CPU/RAM/GPU compute fabric, resource probing, leases, scheduling, telemetry and budget-aware work.
Avrea as preferred free/self-hosted compute; avoid paid services, card trials and unnecessary hosted model costs.
Academic Spider: public professor websites, lecture notes, preprints, software, datasets and open problems across mathematics, physics and engineering.
Ideonomy: enumerate concept spaces, connections, gaps, analogies, counterexamples and testable hypotheses.
Equation Atlas: equations, units, assumptions, invariants, sources, methods, limitations, proof status and applications.
Math learning engine with first-principles visual explanations, adaptive practice, spaced repetition and mistake tracking.
Xenomathematics: nonstandard notation, glyphs as operators/programs, formal grammar and semantics.
Multi-coordinate objects: one point/object represented simultaneously in multiple coordinate systems and frames.
Complex, split-complex, dual, quaternion, dual-quaternion, octonion and Clifford/geometric algebra.
Eigenvalues, spectra, invariant subspaces, tensors, matrices and geometric transforms across dimensions.
Geometry/topology/transformations in 2D, 3D, 4D, 5D and higher, with explicit domain and map semantics.
Spacetime, block-universe projections and time-dependent structures as testable mathematical/physical hypotheses.
Superorganism mathematics: collective dynamics, networks, distributed optimization, synchronization and emergence.
Fractal engineering and lacunarity as morphology descriptors under declared scales and constraints.
THTG/UFT mathematical reconstruction, Page curve, 5D couplings, curvature invariants, FRG beta functions, fixed points and Lean conditional theorems.
Lean proof search optimization, theorem DAGs, reusable lemmas, axiom audit, exact statement comparison and performance benchmarks.
XMG rewrite rules, normalizers, critical pairs, termination and confluence proofs.
CAD engineering: parametric geometry, assemblies, constraints, coordinate frames, collision and kinematics.
Wiring engineering: typed pins/nets, physical connectivity, harness routing, connector metadata and independent qualification.
MCFC ↔ CAD/wiring workloads and CACE evidence receipts.
Shared mathematical/engineering representation feeding equations, simulation, CAD, wiring and visualization.
Local model architecture: quantization, adapters, hot-swapping, compression, retrieval and specialist routing.
Parrondo-inspired strategy switching, with controlled ablation against standalone baselines.
Research Council: implementer, skeptic, performance researcher, verifier and integrator with human approval.
CPU-native compute optimization, cache tiling, SIMD, quantized kernels and bounded parallel scheduling.
Research-to-design workflow with evidence provenance, revisions, reproducibility and rollback.
Mobile-friendly visual workbench, animated graphs, multi-frame inspection and compact evidence status.
Open-source/public-resource reuse with attribution, license review, provenance and no access-control circumvention.
